description: This file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass used in an Android application to display log data through a custom LogView component. It sets up the UI components, manages layout and styling, and listens for text changes to auto-scroll to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that contains a custom LogView and manages its display within a scrollable view, capturing log output and updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's view hierarchy, sets up a text listener on the LogView to auto-scroll when text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by the fragment.
